newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Yacht overturns off Azores, crew member missing.
newsitem.headline: Yacht overturns off Azores, crew member missing.

text.p: Merchant ships and a Portuguese air force plane were looking for a man who went missing after a yacht overturned off the mid-Atlantic Azores islands, a Portuguese navy spokesman said on Wednesday.

"The Gibraltar-registered 'Anita B' overturned about 240 km (150 miles) east of the island of Sao Miguel and sent out a distress signal on Monday," Commander Silva Coelho told Reuters by telephone from the Azores.
"Three of the four-man crew were rescued by a merchant ship and taken to the southern Spanish port of Algeciras today, but the other man is still missing," he added.
Silva Coelho declined to give the nationalities of the crew, but the Portuguese news agency Lusa said that they were three Germans and an Australian.
The Portuguese navy spokesman said relatives of the missing man were being informed.
He said he did not know why the yacht had overturned, but Lusa said rough seas were to blame.
Silva Coelho said that the yacht had set off from Ponta Delgada on Sao Miguel, one of the nine-island Azores archipelago, on May 16 en route to Lisbon.
